chose: the proposer is a maximum weight matching with each admitted pair weighing 21 minus its cost, so a kid without a pair costs 10.5; maximum cardinality rejected
because: measured on the four real rosters: cardinality first doubles the total cost to force the last three pairs; the sit-out price at 10.5 keeps the two-class rule, adds one to two pairs on three-team rosters and removes the one 26.5 pair greedy made

chose: ties between equal pairings resolve to the lowest candidate rank sum, exact integer weights, not the greedy's first-pair order
over: lexicographic tie-break by repeated matching runs
because: lexicographic needs up to one matching run per candidate; the rank sum is deterministic and the tests assert structure, not which equal partner

chose: ERP stays a tiebreak at a tenth per point
over: raise ERP to break an age tie
because: ERP is null on every real roster; the leaderboard link filled it for two test events only; re-weight when ratings arrive
